【Wild Squirt Swap】Part 1 | A Game for Three Couples 👙 (21:37mins)

A nomadic couple from Europe came here to stay for a while, and reached out to us and the Little Chili couple for a different kind of cultural exchange. Before we met, I was excited, and a little curious. Different languages, different habits. Would everyone actually loosen up? One conversation later, I knew there was nothing to worry about. 🤭

Really happy, and grateful to the founder of the IHASF swap group for letting us use a place with an indoor pool for free. Water, space, and the mood softened right away. 🏊

We met around 4. They were friendly and easy to talk to. Travel, relationships, boundaries, what they like to watch. No awkward pauses, no forced chat. It just got more natural. Then the men said they wanted to see the girls in bikinis in the water, so the women changed and we started playing. By the end, they followed local custom and joined us for the King’s Game. 👑

None of us were first-timers, so it moved fast and stayed open. Dancing, kissing, touching, stripping… bodies heated up before our heads caught up. What felt best in that moment wasn’t rushing into it. It was seeing everyone actually enjoy it. Nobody was performing. Eyes met, and the whole mood changed. 💦

I had a really good time. With people I know, and people I had just met, we pushed the heat pretty far…
